exposure: Hormone-related conditions (oral contraceptive use, intrauterine fertilization, pregnancy, tumors of the female reproductive system)
cohort: 72 premenopausal women with surgically treated meningiomas between 2006 and 2019.
finding: No significant differences were found in the biological behaviour or pathological findings of meningiomas, including progesterone receptor expression, between premenopausal women with and without hormone-related conditions.
